Assuming a **full-service upper-upscale hotel in the U.S. or Canada**, owners typically begin with the following brand universe:

### Most frequently shortlisted

| Brand family | Typical candidates |
|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **Marriott Hotels, Sheraton, Westin, Renaissance, Le Méridien, Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio**; **Gaylord Hotels** for large convention/resort projects |
| **Hilton** | **Hilton Hotels & Resorts, Embassy Suites, Canopy by Hilton, Curio Collection by Hilton** |
| **Hyatt** | **Hyatt Regency, Hyatt Centric, JdV by Hyatt**; sometimes **Destination by Hyatt, The Unbound Collection or Thompson** for distinctive resorts and lifestyle hotels |
| **IHG** | **Hotel Indigo, Kimpton, Crowne Plaza and voco**—with the latter two often considered at the upscale/upper-upscale boundary |
| **Other systems** | **Omni Hotels & Resorts, Wyndham Grand, Hard Rock Hotels, Radisson Blu** and, selectively, **Loews Hotels** |

Marriott’s full-service portfolio is especially broad, including hard brands and collection affiliations that allow an independent design approach. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) Hilton’s recent North American development activity includes Hilton, Embassy Suites, Canopy, Curio and DoubleTree projects. ([stories-editor.hilton.com](https://stories-editor.hilton.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/2025-Development-Awards-Winners-List.pdf?utm_source=openai)) Hyatt explicitly positions Hyatt Regency, Hyatt Centric and JdV in the upper-upscale category, with several collection and lifestyle brands spanning upper-upscale and luxury. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands?utm_source=openai)) IHG identifies Hotel Indigo as upper-upscale lifestyle and places Crowne Plaza and voco in its premium portfolio. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2023/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-underlines-commitment-to-growth-and-leadership-in-the-premium-category)) Wyndham positions Wyndham Grand directly in the upper-upscale market. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/brand/wyndham-grand/?utm_source=openai))

### Frequently considered “adjacent” brands

Depending on the market, cost plan and targeted ADR, the first round may also include:

- **DoubleTree by Hilton**
- **Delta Hotels by Marriott**
- **Crowne Plaza**
- **voco**
- **Tapestry Collection by Hilton**
- **Graduate by Hilton**
- **Sonesta Hotels**
- **Dolce by Wyndham**

These are often attractive for conversions or projects where a conventional upper-upscale prototype would not underwrite. Some currently sit in the **upscale** chain scale even though developers may still consider them against upper-upscale alternatives.

### How the shortlist normally changes by project type

- **Conventional urban/suburban full service:** Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt Regency, Sheraton, Westin, Renaissance, Crowne Plaza.
- **Lifestyle/boutique:** Autograph, Curio, Tribute, Canopy, Hyatt Centric, JdV, Hotel Indigo, Kimpton.
- **Convention headquarters:** Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt Regency, Embassy Suites, Gaylord; occasionally Signia or Grand Hyatt at the upper end.
- **Resort:** Westin, Autograph, Curio, Hyatt Regency, Destination, Omni, Hard Rock, Wyndham Grand.
- **Conversion/adaptive reuse:** Autograph, Tribute, Curio, JdV, Hotel Indigo, voco, DoubleTree.
- **All-suite/group-oriented:** Embassy Suites is usually the principal upper-upscale candidate.

**Important distinction:** STR chain scale is rate-based and can change annually; it is not identical to how hotel companies describe their brands as “premium,” “lifestyle” or “luxury.” For example, certain familiar full-service brands may move between upscale and upper-upscale as systemwide ADR changes. ([costar.com](https://www.costar.com/products/str-benchmark/resources/guidelines/str-chain-scales?utm_source=openai))

For most U.S./Canadian feasibility studies, a practical initial shortlist is therefore:

**Marriott, Sheraton, Westin, Renaissance, Autograph, Tribute, Hilton, Embassy Suites, Canopy, Curio, Hyatt Regency, Hyatt Centric, JdV, Hotel Indigo, voco, Crowne Plaza, Omni and Wyndham Grand.**
